scope: Read-only review of initial and same-route async UI ownership, opening-state draft revision lock, scoped player/speech cleanup and pending durable draft flush. No runtime edits by reviewer.
method: Synthetic profiles/threads; actual local router and native IndexedDB in isolated browser contexts. Delayed native open-success delivery and a real saved draft revision. No model inference, no personal learner history, no physical-device claim.

independentBefore.method: Actual saved conversation and native IDB; delay open-success delivery, type into exposed composer before current revision is read, then release.

result.status: Another unsent draft was recovered. Save it before continuing.View recovered draft

independentAfter.method: Actual saved conversation and native IDB; delay open-success delivery, attempt synthetic edit while composer is disabled, release actual saved revision, then make a real first edit and verify navigation/flush/resume.

result.status: An approved offline conversation pack is not available in this release. Saved conversations remain accessible.

afterNavigationAssertion.method: First normal edit after the opening lock released, immediately navigate to Profile, then reopen the exact conversation; composer restores the edit after the controller disposal draftQueue flush.

independentCodeReview: UI render generation/profile/learner/epoch is checked separately from durable repository profile/learner ownership.
Immediate hashchange disposal prevents late initial hub/player UI publication, including away/back ABA.
Scoped viewport owner and view lease prevent old cleanup from removing newer player controls or stopping unrelated playback.
Interaction listeners stop immediately; repository remains current during already queued durable draft flush and then closes.

Initial controller publications are held until load resolves; buttons/inputs/textarea are disabled while Back remains available. Synthetic input cannot create a draft before saved revision is established.
Late speech acquisition releases its lease without recording or playback after navigation.
